<insights>
- Wes Johnson worked on multiple games including Fallout 4 and World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth.
- The game with a cover showing a gun-wielding man is World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth.
</insights>

<answer>
Wes Johnson was involved in the game World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth earlier than Fallout 4.
</answer>

<subanswer>
- Fallout 4 was released in 2015.
- World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth was released in 2018.
</subanswer>
